data.name: Sheetal
data.gender_notes: Sheetal is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bringing the essence of coolness, calmness and serenity. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'sheet' meaning cool and 'ala' meaning wave, this name is often given to children born during spring time. The name Sheetal carries the meaning “Cool, Calm, Serene” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sheetal usually hope their child will grow to embody cool, calm, serene and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of the Goddess Sheetala, Sheetal signifies coolness, peace and serenity. It is believed that the name bestows grace, beauty and a calm mind on the child.
data.etymology: Sheetal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cool, Calm, Serene.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sheetal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
